evidence: 5F1986/5F1994 reads Sprite dimensions at+18/+1C;5F19B5-5F19C9 compares them against g_WIN_BUFFER at9B6F08 plus80/84 (DIB biWidth and negated biHeight). The existing separate WinSavedAreaWidth/Height globals at9B6F88/9B6F8C overlap those real members. Init at5F19D4 receives width,height,0,0, not sprite pointer values.

5F1A0C-5F1A1C uses ScreenBuffer as receiver and g_WIN_BUFFER as destination: save screen pixels to the cursor backing buffer. The restore paths use the opposite direction.5F1ACC-5F1ADD directly passes the loaded borrowed HCURSOR to SetCursor; resource loading belongs only to the distinct cursor_name_ path at5F1AEB-5F1B02.

Preserve observable rereads: fresh cursor_sprite_ for height after storing width, fresh global dimensions after init, fresh sprite publication after init, and global coordinates/dimensions after copy. These corrections fit authorized existing Win/Sprite/Buffer member usage; no Sprite/Buffer header or unrelated owner body is edited. The broader Buffer lifetimes and strict reference closure remain independent verification obligations.
payload.hypothesis: The same cursor operation misidentifies Buffer dimension members as globals, uses pointers as dimensions, reverses save-copy ownership and treats a borrowed cursor handle as a resource ID. Recover these existing typed owners with the cursor contract.
